translation:
Treats wounds that have not healed for many years, rotten wound openings, metal wounds and arrow shots, broken skin from blows, with blood flowing out without stopping. This medicine may be pressed dry onto [the wound]. The next day, use another medicinal water to wash it clean and press [the medicine] on again. It is greatly able to disperse blood and close the opening.

Shigao/gypsum one jin (sealed with yellow mud and calcined), Baifan/alum two liang (sublimed), Xuejie/Dragon's blood one liang (ground separately), Huangdan/lead oxide (finely ground, sublimed over fire, and water-sublimed), Songtang/pine sugar (ground separately), Wubeizi/gallnut, Fenshuang/calomel, each three liang, Longgu/dragon bone two liang (ground separately). The above are ground into an extremely fine powder and stored in a jar for use.
